filename: Edward MacDowell - To a Wild Rose.md
title: To a Wild Rose
identity: The cataloged alto saxophone and piano version is a Richard Hall arrangement published by Dorn Publications as DORN1345. This is distinct from the Willis Coggins arrangement in Belwin’s *Student Instrumental Course, Level Two*, which is cataloged separately and derives from MacDowell’s original solo-piano miniature in *Woodland Sketches*, Op. 51. The target DORN1345 score was not available for inspection.

evidence.claim: Catalog lead identifies Dorn Publications DORN1345 and Richard Hall as arranger for the saxophone and piano item.
CiNii library record describes Coggins/Girlamo version for alto saxophone and piano as Level Two, first published by Belwin Mills circa 1970, and notes the source was originally solo piano.
evidence.source_name: CiNii Books, National Institute of Informatics

evidence.claim: Belwin listing identifies the separate Willis Coggins arrangement as Grade 2 and its school/community usage label.
Faber Music identifies MacDowell’s original piano work as *To a Wild Rose*, Op. 51 No. 1.

collection_flag: A transcription of MacDowell’s solo-piano piece. One separately cataloged Coggins saxophone edition carries a Level Two school-course designation; that descriptor does not establish the target Dorn edition’s difficulty.
gaps: The arranger/version mismatch between the catalog’s Richard Hall DORN1345 item and the Coggins edition is unresolved; locate the Dorn publisher record or score.
No score or saxophone performance inspected for either edition.
